interpretations: For each rating, show the rating, its average rental rate divided by its average replacement cost, its film count, and its ratio minus the unweighted average of the five ratings’ ratios; ignore missing values in each average and do not round.
queries:
WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  ratio,
  film_count,
  ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM rating_stats) AS difference_from_average
FROM rating_stats
